services.name: Skydive With Us
services.desc: Fun jumpers are the heartbeat of Piedmont Skydiving. Whether you’re logging your hundredth jump or chasing your next license, our DZ is the place to be: good vibes only, speedy aircraft, high altitude, easy to get to, and we’re open February through mid-December! Piedmont Skydiving is more than a place to jump, it’s a place to belong. We’re known for our super active community of kind, friendly fun jumpers. Stay connected through our Experienced Jumpers Facebook Group for weather updates, aircraft calls, and event news. Our PAC 750 XL climbs fast, fits up to 16 jumpers, and is built for efficiency. blurb: Guests skydive from altitudes up to 17,500 feet with professional instructors, experiencing freefall and landing on the dropzone. They offer tandem skydives and an Accelerated Free Fall (AFF) program for training. The dropzone is located in Salisbury, NC, central to several cities including Charlotte and Greensboro.
